componentDescription: A graphical display of a numeric value within a known range, such as storage used or battery level.

classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

color.description: The color of the component. It supports both default and custom theme colors, which can be added as shown in the palette customization guide.

getAriaValueText.description: A function that returns a string value that provides a human-readable text alternative for aria-valuenow, the current value of the meter.

label.description: The label of the meter. Screen readers announce it as the meter's name.

locale.description: The locale used by Intl.NumberFormat when formatting the value. Defaults to the user's runtime locale.

render.description: Replaces the rendered root element while keeping the meter styles. Accepts an element or a function that receives the props and the Base UI state.

renderValue.description: Renders the visible value. Receives the formatted value and the raw value. Setting it also shows the value.

showValue.description: If true, the formatted value is displayed next to the label.

slotProps.description: The props used for each slot inside.

slots.description: The components used for each slot inside.

sx.description: The system prop that allows defining system overrides as well as additional CSS styles.

slotDescriptions.indicator: The component that renders the indicator.
slotDescriptions.label: The component that renders the label.
slotDescriptions.root: The component that renders the root.
slotDescriptions.track: The component that renders the track.
slotDescriptions.value: The component that renders the formatted value.
